description.value: Mount Arrowsmith Brewing Company is a family-run craft brewery one block from downtown Parksville on Vancouver Island, producing a wide range of house beers from crisp lagers to bold IPAs and sours. The west-coast-themed tasting room serves pints, tasting flights, and cans to go, alongside the on-site Arrowsmith Smokehouse offering Southern-style BBQ, pizzas, and handhelds. The brewery is active in the local community and regularly hosts ticketed events including live music nights and outdoor craft beer festivals.

address.value: 109-425 Stanford Avenue E, Parksville, BC V9P 2N4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms an active craft brewery and tasting room in Parksville with dine-in and takeout service, consistent with OSM tags (amenity=pub, microbrewery=yes). Phone and street address match between OSM and website; OSM opening hours appear outdated compared to current website hours. No bike-specific infrastructure, washroom mentions, water refill, wifi, or e-bike charging are referenced anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM name is 'Mount Arrowsmith Tasting Room' but the business's own website consistently uses 'Mount Arrowsmith Brewing Company' or 'Arrowsmith Brewing'.
OSM opening_hours (Mo-Th, Su 11:30-19:30) appear outdated; website shows later closing times (9pm–10pm depending on day).
Website footer contains a typo ('Standford Ave E.') though the contact page correctly spells 'Stanford Avenue E.'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active craft brewery and tasting room with full food service in Parksville — a clear and welcoming stop for touring cyclists seeking a meal or drink on Vancouver Island.

wow_evidence: family-run craft brewery one block from downtown Parksville
